about_the_game:
With each wave, enemies become stronger, bosses deadlier, and loot more valuable. With randomly generated rewards and constantly evolving character traits, a different challenge awaits you every turn. Kill, win, upgrade, start again. Every failure is the foundation of your next victory.

Will you abandon your defenses for greater power, or will you play it safe?

Clear enemy waves, upgrade your stats with the money you earn, take risks, or play it safe. Defeat bosses and collect rewards with mysterious chests.

Every start, a new strategy.

Every strategy is entirely yours.

- Fight solo or with friends in co-op.

- Wave-based combat with increasingly powerful enemies.

- Test your character with the bosses you face.

- Choose your strategy: Damage, speed, armor, or combo—the choice is yours.

- Choose your destiny with risk-reward mechanics.

- Survive the arena, slay enemies, and improve yourself with the money you earn.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 1650 or higher.

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K / AMD Ryzen 5

  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 1080 or higher.
